benchmark_name: TerraShift Saudi Deployment Multi-Model Reference Benchmark (v6.0)
description: Rigorous empirical ablation comparing 7 change detection paradigms across 4 Saudi reference corridors under strict greedy 1-to-1 event matching.

methodology_notes.matching_protocol: Strict greedy 1-to-1 matching: predictions sorted by confidence descending; at most 1 TP per reference event; overlapping duplicates categorized as FP_dup; unlinked predictions categorized as FP_bg.
methodology_notes.held_out_generalization: Al-Kharj Industrial & Logistics Corridor evaluated with frozen hyperparameters to test transferability beyond development corridors.
methodology_notes.scl_transparency: Automated Scene Classification Layer (SCL) filters clouds/shadows (classes 3, 8, 9, 10). Note: SCL masks guarantee clear-land surface validity under standard operational criteria, but do not guarantee complete absence of thin sub-pixel cirrus or atmospheric dust haze.
methodology_notes.fair_latency: Pure compute latency (CPU inference + vectorization) is measured independently from network STAC COG range reads.

latency_benchmarks.note: Pure compute latency measures CPU inference and physical polygon vectorization on local hardware independent of cloud STAC range read fetch.
